Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (cut to the boys) What are you up to today?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're racing our remote-controlled monster trucks. (their remotes clicking)

Name: Linda
Dialog: I don't see any monster trucks.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, that's 'cause we rigged them to go light-speed. You know how those stock motors are. They never give you enough action.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (oblivious) You boys have such active imaginations. You must get it from your father.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Let's see... Green goes to number 5. (Laughs) I'm painting!

Name: Linda
Dialog: , (the car arrives) Oh, Charlene's here. I'm off to my cooking class.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Bye, Mom. Final lap, Ferb. (The cars suddenly materialize and speed off, leaving behind trails of fire a la Back to the Future) Aw! Another photo finish. I'm never watching closely enough to see who won.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (laying on her bed in her room, she answers her video phone as it rings; it's Stacy) Despair speaking.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Care to explain why "Despair" isn't picking up her cell phone this morning?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Because of a little thing called PARALLEL PARKING! See yesterday, Dad was teaching me how to drive...

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay, Candace. All you have to do is park between this plastic trash can, and that plastic trash can.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So I put it in reverse... (drives back and forth slamming into the two trash cans) Aah! (8x)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (present day; moving phone back and forth) Aah! (3x) (Sobbing) Then Dad said my parallel parking needs a little work! (Inhales) It means I'll never get my driver's license! I'm such a loser.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh my gosh, Ferb. I can't believe it! I've never noticed how soft our carpets are. But more importantly, we have to help Candace get her confidence back. Any ideas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This is perfect! The Candace Crusher! Nothing says confidence like a monster truck. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Oh, hey Agent P. So, get this

Name: Carl
Dialog: And Carl.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I already told you your name's not that cool. Anyway, do your stuff, Agent P, and stop that- DOOF! (Laughs)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Take it all the way back. Keep it moving. Waterfall, the orange cones, parts, left to the garage, bleachers, right, um, Giant Baby Head... anywhere's good.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Instrumental

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Dad, you might want to wipe the Queen off your face.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, oh, yeah, thanks. (Notices the monster truck) Crikey, a monster truck!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! Isn't it sweet!? It's to help teach Candace how to parallel park and stuff. We figured if she learned how to drive one of these monsters, she’d have the confidence to drive anything.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh yeah, brilliant. But I better check with Mum about this. (At phone) Uh, hello honey, yes, yes, oh gosh, I love you too, darling. Uh, are you aware the boys have a monster truck in the backyard?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (at Chef Guilbaud's) Honestly, you're as bad as Candace.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay, okay. Just checking. (At Phineas and Ferb) It's a go, boys! I'll get your sister!

Name: Cooking Instructor
Dialog: (Shift back to the Cooking class) Ahem. Madam Flynn, I have told you a hundred times, (Bashes phone, word-by-word) No phone calls in class! (Phone ringing; Laughs) Hello? (To Linda) It is for you.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, I think the boys are building a monster truck.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Um, honey, I gotta go. No- B-Big chef. Big meat tenderizer in front of mommy. Bye bye.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, this seems like a good idea.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I've gotcha.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, what's the point? I'm never gonna be able to parallel park.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry, sis. It's just to build your confidence.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay, don't forget to buckle up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But we can't drive here. It's just the backyard. (Phineas and Ferb pulls rope, revealing the Monster Truck Rally) Meap!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Gentlemen, I have a unique investment opportunity for you. I'm sure you're all aware of the popularity of monster trucks, right But you know, they are not really monsters, just big, stupid trucks! So, I came up with my own line of monster trucks! Behold! (Electric Guitar) Very evil, don't you think? And there's even one that looks like me! Look, look! (Laughs) We'll corner the markets! And just to be sure, I have created

Name: Evil Investor
Dialog: But is it safe to use?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sure, let me demonstrate. (Fires laser, shooting at the evil investor) See? It doesn't affect people at all! (the evil investor's head swells up) Except maybe a little swelling, but don't worry, it will go down. You know, probably. Now, watch what it does to this miniature monster truck! (Fires laser; Evil Investors talking at once) I don't know where it sends them, maybe another dimension.

Name: Alien
Dialog: (Eats the miniature truck)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (shift back to D.E.I.) Of course, that was just a toy. Let's try it out on a real monster truck. Huh? Which brings me to my next invention. The Monster Truck Locate-Inator! (notices the animal at top) Perry the Platypus? Guess what? That's not a monster truck locate-inator at all! It's a Chinese platypus trap! (Laughs) I got you. Here's the real Locate-inator! Okay, now, where is the nearest monster truck? Yes! Right here in Danville! Okay, everybody, get in me and we'll go.

Name: Evil Investor
Dialog: Are you sure you want to bring him?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? Well, yes, of course. He's my nemesis. I have to show him everything.

Name: News Reporter
Dialog: Good afternoon, Danville! Dink Winkerson here, and this is little Isabella Garcia-Shapiro from Fireside Girl Troop 46231. And she's got a little announcement to make.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (inhales, man's voice) Wednesday, Wednesday, Wednesday! Giant monster truck rally right here in Danville! Candace the Crusher takes on all comers! Be there, be there, be there! We'll give you the whole seat, but you'll only need the edge! (normal voice) Thanks, Dink.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All right, Candace. All you have to do is maneuver through this traffic cone course.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh. So I put it into drive... AAH! AAH! AAH! AAH!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I don't think we're gonna get the deposit back on those cones.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (the next course) Okay, Candace. All you have to do on this test is go up this gentle incline.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad, you look nervous.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: No, of course not. I- I have full confidence in you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Rock music) Phineas, this incline is getting kind of steep!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry, Candace. It gets steeper! (Monster truck revving) Next, the break portion of the test. (Squeaking; Crowd cheering)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) I can't believe I did it!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (Breaks handle) Oh, well done!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, left on to Maple Drive, and here we are! Oh, great. There's no parking spot! I should've invented a Parked Car Away-Inator.

Name: Evil Investor
Dialog: Oh, ja! Zat is something that I vould buy.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, look at him. He's got a big head, suddenly some sort of marketing genius.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, well done, Candace! Next we'll- (Cars revving)

Name: Monster Truck Driver
Dialog: You're Candace the Crusher?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes...?

Name: Monster Truck Driver
Dialog: I heard pigs could fly, but now I've seen everything! (Laughs)

Name: Candace
Dialog: That doesn't make any sense.

Name: Monster Truck Driver
Dialog: It doesn't have to; I got a monster truck! Woohoo..!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Candace, those dudes need to suck our mud!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's a photo finish! The winner will now be decided by our final event

Name: Candace
Dialog: Parallel Parking?

Name: Monster Truck Driver
Dialog: Ha ha! You're goin' down, girlie! Check out the finesse! (Backs up car, hits trash can) AAAAAAAAH! (repeatedly bashes the trash cans) AAH! AAH! AAH...!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: See, Candace? Even a trained professional has trouble from time to time. Now, I want you to just relax, and park this car!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Parks car perfectly) Yes!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (Playing Fanfare)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (as Ferb plays the bugle) Ferb?! (Crowd cheering)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Time for some Monster Truck Away-Inating! Okay, steady now... Here we-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? But-but, but how did you get out of the Chinese platypus trap?

Name: Man
Dialog: Ancient Chinese secret. (snip snip)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't remember inviting him. (To Perry) No, wait! Perry the Platypus! No, no! Please! Don't turn that dial to the "Doofenshmirtz mobile and Evil Investors away-inator"! (Perry flips switch) I have to rethink my dials. (Car disappears)

Name: Evil Investor
Dialog: Hey, look guys! My swelling went down!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, shut up.

Name: Alien
Dialog: (Eats Doofenshmirtz and evil investors; Burps)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Bubble pops) Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I did it!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I'm proud of you, darling. You really made them eat mud.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Comes out of monster truck and falls onto mud)

Name: Monster Truck Driver
Dialog: Gotta admit it girl. You're good.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, aren't you Buck Buckerson? The famous monster truck rally promoter?

Name: Buck Buckerson
Dialog: That's right, and me and my boys are headed to a rally up in Badgertown. Only the track up there ain't near as good as this one.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You can have ours. We're through with it.

Name: Buck Buckerson
Dialog: That's mighty nice of you. (cut to the front of the house) Haul her away, boys.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (she came back the cooking class) Thanks for the ride, Charlene. (Ferb the presses button and monster truck turns into car)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, why on earth are you all covered in mud?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (reciting the song he sang with Phineas in the Rally) Because she's a tire-spinning, gear-grinding, clutch-burning, backfiring, paint-trading, red-lining, overheating, throttle-stomping truck drivin' girl.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And, I learned how to parallel park!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Great!
